spans.s: सुबल m. N. of a myth. bird etc.

सुबहु a. very much (many);
 ˚शस् adv. very often.

सुबाहु॑ a. handsome-armed;
 m. N. of a serpent-demon etc.

सुबीज n. good seed;
 a. having good seed.
1 सुबुद्धि f. good under standing, wisdom.
सुबोध (f. ई) a. easy to be understood.
सुबोध˚न (f. ई) a. easy to be understood.

सुब्रह्मण्य॑ a. very kind to Brahmans. m. a cert.
priest, f. आ॑ a cert. recitation performed by this priest, also the
priest himself.
2 सुब्र॑ह्मन् a. having good prayers or a good Brahman.
